description.value: The Lasqueti Island Hotel is located on Lasqueti Island, a small, off-grid island in the Strait of Georgia accessible only by a passenger-only ferry from French Creek near Parksville. For touring cyclists, reaching the hotel already requires a ferry crossing, making it a genuinely remote destination in the Gulf Islands region. The island is known for its rural, self-sufficient character, which shapes the experience of any accommodation there.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned a security warning page (Advanced Security blocked the domain as a potential threat, redirecting to cf.miniroad.store), meaning no usable hotel website content is available. All fields therefore rely on OSM tags only. OSM confirms a hotel building at 1 Weldon Road with a phone number and internet_access=wlan, but per rules OSM amenity tags are not treated as authoritative without website confirmation.
concerns: Website domain (lasqueti-islandhotel.com) appears to have been hijacked or expired and taken over: the fetch was blocked by security software as a threat, redirecting to cf.miniroad.store. No actual hotel content was retrievable.
Because the website is inaccessible, no amenity fields could be confirmed from the website source. All amenity values are null.
The compromised website raises uncertainty about whether the business is still actively operating. Manual verification recommended.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The hotel's OSM record appears legitimate (real island, real address, building tagged), but the website domain has been compromised and redirects to a malicious third-party site, making it impossible to verify current operation. Manual verification of whether the business is still operating is needed before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Lasqueti Island is served by a passenger-only ferry from French Creek; cyclists must be able to bring bikes on the ferry to reach this property. The island has limited infrastructure overall.

wow_evidence: off-grid island in the Strait of Georgia accessible only by a passenger-only ferry from French Creek near Parksville
